steps.rationale: F1 — calibration is missing 62 % of the time at the hill station and 6 % elsewhere: the missingness depends on the station, and the station is the label — a median within the station would carry the label into the row's features, which the executor refuses — so the train median fills it and the indicator keeps the mechanism visible

alternatives.when: if the missingness were judged uninformative (a median grouped by the station is not an alternative: the station is the label)

downstream.preprocessing: the indicator carries the missingness mechanism the median cannot
downstream.leakage: the median is fitted on train alone; no label reaches the features

steps.rationale: F2 — the reading is autocorrelated at lag 1 and has a daily period; the previous hour and the same hour yesterday are the two features that carry it

alternatives.when: if the model must work on the first reading of a new station, where no lag exists

downstream.modeling: the first rows of each station carry a missing lag

steps.rationale: the daily period the analysis measured needs an hour a model can read, and the cyclic pair keeps 23:00 next to 00:00

downstream.model_family: a linear model needs the sin/cos pair

steps.rationale: F3 — Moran's I is ~1 for the coordinates and 0.34 for the reading: location carries signal, and neighbourhood density is the feature that expresses it

alternatives.when: if the model should see a cell id rather than a density
